user.title: LokalTerm setup
user.description: Enter the local TCP connection settings for the boiler module.

data_description.name: How the boiler appears on dashboard cards and in the device list.
data_description.devid: The vId identifier from the internet module or boiler controller.
data_description.devpin: The vPin code from the boiler panel that signs local LAN commands.
data_description.listen_host: Local IP address for the TCP server in Home Assistant. Leave 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.
data_description.listen_port: TCP port where the boiler module sends status frames. Default is 1088, from 1 to 65535.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid IP address or hostname without spaces.
error.invalid_port: Enter a whole port number from 1 to 65535.
error.port_in_use: Another LokalTerm entry is already listening on this port.
error.cannot_bind: Home Assistant can't open this TCP address or port. Check if another service is already using it.

abort.already_configured: Home Assistant already has a device with this vId.
